name: Sainted Shaftcollar
description: Stand in the court's posture with the orb lowered and the shaft held high across the chest.

name: Ballcrown
description: Let the orb fall from the high guard onto the shoulder of the foe in the school's plain opening stroke.

name: Burrgrace
description: Turn on the lead foot in the court's measured pace so the orb comes round behind the step.

name: Pummelcrown
description: Rake the studded orb along the foe's guard arm with a thin line of qi that sharpens each spike.

name: Faithful Headspike
description: Beat an incoming cut aside with the shaft in the school's short rising parry and swing the orb back.

name: Commanding Prickball
description: Catch the foe's sleeve with a spike and draw the arm across his own body, spoiling his stroke.

name: Noble Topspike
description: Drive the leading spike into the seam of a plate with a push of loaded qi along the shaft.

name: Harmonious Pummel
description: Link strike, guard and strike in the court's round, shaft and orb each covering the other's return.

name: Magnificent Thornbite
description: Hold the orb overhead while qi gathers, then release it to bear the foe down under its weight.

name: Peerless Quenched Studcrush
description: The school's culminating stroke: the orb drops from the full height of the court guard with all gathered qi behind it.

name: Venerable Spikering
description: Open with the shaft crossing the body on a slant, the orb trailing like a second current.

name: Crunchverdict
description: Swing the orb out first, the main current of the pair, to draw the foe's guard.

name: Thistlesolace
description: Slip a pace aside in a small circle, like an eddy, so the foe's thrust finds nothing.

name: Maultriumph
description: Bring the orb back on a second line behind the first and strike the side the guard turned from.

name: Enshrined Ballsocket
description: Let the shaft eddy backward and catch the foe's blade as it slides past the orb.

name: Ruling Topspike
description: Set a spike in the foe's shield rim and hold it there like a snag on a sandbar.

name: Lordly Thornbite
description: Land two spikes side by side in an armor gap with a short qi-backed shove.

name: Orchestral Maul
description: Run a fast chain of swings and steps that pours the pair of strokes over the foe without a pause.

name: Imperial Spikeball
description: Break both currents into a broad loaded sweep that strikes all foes standing in the arc.

name: Matchless Headspike
description: The school's paired stroke: one spike draws the guard, and a second driven spike follows through behind it.

name: Sacrosanct Spikebase
description: Settle the weight into both feet with the orb low, in the posture taken at either of the twin courts.

name: Maulbanner
description: Crush the orb down on the foe's left shoulder in the first of the school's two courtly strokes.

name: Pummeldecree
description: Cross to the right and crush the orb onto the other shoulder, the answer to the first stroke.

name: Inviolate Ballsocket
description: Plant the shaft vertically and lean into it so a heavy blow breaks against the school's brace.

name: Entropy Prickball
description: Sweep the orb round the body in a steady circle as the school does when pressed by many.

name: Despotic Thornball
description: Hook the heavy orb over a raised weapon and drag it down so the foe's arm is pulled low.

name: Triumphant Studball
description: Load the falling orb with qi along the shaft so it lands far heavier than its swing suggests.

name: Symphonic Crunch
description: Step through the left and right crushes in quick order, each blow landing a step nearer the foe.

name: Intrepid Spikebase
description: Wedge a spike into the joint left open by the second crush and drive it deeper with the shaft.

name: Majestic Spikeball
description: Bring the orb down over both shoulders in turn with gathered qi, bearing the foe to his knees.

name: Exalted Bedrock Spikering
description: The school's shared crushing blow, in which both courts' strokes fall as one weight on the foe's centre.

name: Immaculate Shaftcollar
description: Hold the shaft level at the chest like the rim of a basin, orb hanging at its low point.

name: Burrtriumph
description: Dip the orb from high to low in a swift stoop onto the foe's knee.

name: Ballvoyage
description: Step in to the foe along a low line, the way a hawk follows a valley's air.

name: Crunchbanner
description: Drop the orb into the hollow of the foe's raised guard as water drops into a cupped hand.

name: Undefiled Spikebase
description: Beat the shaft against a cut and then fan the head outward like a raptor's wing.

name: Unbending Studball
description: Press the orb onto the foe's foot while the shaft holds his weapon, settling him like silt.

name: Choral Pummel
description: Strike high with the hawk's stoop, then low with the basin's fall, so the foe's guard cannot cover both.

name: Heroic Topspike
description: Gather qi high above the foe and dive the leading spike through plate in a single narrow plunge.

name: Solar Studcrush
description: Let the basin overflow in a wide level sweep that strikes every foe at the edge of the arc.

name: Paramount Thornball
description: The school's joined stroke: a hawk's stoop lifts the guard and the basin's weight comes down through the gap.

name: Devout Ballsocket
description: Hold the shaft slanted across the body and the orb ready, the first track of the school's power.

name: Thistlecrown
description: Swing the orb low and level along the ground track, aimed at the foe's lead leg.

name: Maulodyssey
description: Move across the foe's line like the shadow of a cloud, the orb following with no pause.

name: Dauntless Spikeball
description: Weave the two streams of qi through shaft and orb so they join as the head lands.

name: Stately Headspike
description: Spread a screen of field qi in front of the shaft to stop a cut before it reaches the wood.

name: Unrivaled Thornbite
description: Thread the leading spike through a gap in the armor and widen it with a quick twist of the shaft.

name: Masterful Prickball
description: Hook the foe's weapon with one track and strike with the other so he has no hand free to recover.

name: Grand Spikering
description: Roll three loaded strikes one after another like waves, each fed by the qi left over from the last.

name: Tyrannous Studball
description: Drop the orb on the foe's weapon so hard that it is driven into the ground and held.

name: Sphere Topspike
description: Unite body and field qi in one spike and bear down on the foe until he cannot rise.

name: Sovereign Vigor Headspike
description: The school's two-track blow: both streams of qi meet in the orb as it falls from the full height of the guard.

name: Revered Spikebase
description: Stand with the shaft held as one river and the orb as the other, ready to meet.

name: Pummelbanner
description: Begin a swing small and light, like a spring, and let it gather weight as it travels.

name: Crunchgrace
description: Spread the feet into several short paces that fan out round the foe like a delta's mouths.

name: Storied Ballsocket
description: Send a pulse of Core qi into the orb at impact so that the studs land as a single heavy mass.

name: Undaunted Spikering
description: Fold the guard around the foe's blade as an estuary folds around a current, drawing it harmlessly past.

name: Peremptory Headspike
description: Hook a spike on the foe's weapon and drag it down with the pull of the shaft, as a tide drags sand.

name: Resonant Maul
description: Chain a light opening stroke to a heavy closing one, the second riding the first.

name: Valiant Prickball
description: Meet the foe at the exact point where shaft and orb lines cross and drive a spike home.

name: Kernel Thornball
description: Release the gathered Core qi into a broad loaded sweep that strikes every foe within its arc.

name: Majestic Studcrush
description: The school's highest stroke: two rivers of Core qi meet in the orb and the head falls on the foe together.

name: Consecrated Topspike
description: Stand tall at the edge of open ground with the shaft angled forward, taking the wind-sworn stance.

name: Balledict
description: Swing the orb up and out as if the wind were pulling it, then let it drop on the target.

name: Thistleboon
description: Skirt the foe at a long stride so the orb arrives from the side he cannot guard.

name: Royal Studball
description: Whip the studded orb across the foe with a gust of qi that sharpens each stud.

name: Faithful Spikebase
description: Turn the shaft in a quick half-circle to throw a cut wide, as the wind turns a thrown leaf.

name: Authoritative Spikering
description: Snare the foe's cloak on a spike and tug so he stumbles into the swing of the orb.

name: Exalted Prickball
description: Thrust the spike at the full reach of the shaft with qi gathered to its point.

name: Harmonious Crunch
description: Chain sweep, thrust and drop across the foe's front, each carried by the last stroke's momentum.

name: Matchless Ballsocket
description: Hold the swing at its peak while qi gathers like a held gust, then drop it and pin the foe.

name: Majestic Squall Thornball
description: The school's sworn stroke: a long swing is held on the wind of the breath, then loosed on the foe in one fall.

name: Unwavering Shaftcollar
description: Plant the feet on the line of the oath and hold the shaft before the chest.

name: Maulcrown
description: Strike down from the full height of the shaft as a boulder rolls off a plateau.

name: Burrvoyage
description: Advance along a single steady line, never giving ground, with the orb swinging at each step.

name: Thistledecree
description: Speak the sworn word and swing, letting qi settle in the head to give the stroke a vow's weight.

name: Sainted Headspike
description: Hold the guard to the sworn side and turn each cut along it with the haft.

name: Subjugating Thornball
description: Anchor a spike in the foe's gear and hold the line so he cannot step away.

name: Famed Topspike
description: Thrust the sworn spike through a gap in the armor with qi gathered along the line of the oath.

name: Grand Pummel
description: Deliver the school's strokes in their fixed order, each pledged to the next, without breaking the line.

name: Commanding Spikering
description: Lean the loaded orb onto the foe's weapon and bear down until his grip fails under the vow's weight.

name: Peerless Prickball
description: The school's oath stroke: the orb falls once along the sworn line with every breath of qi held behind it.

name: Gracious Shaftcollar
description: Face the foe, sight along the shaft and take the bearing that all later strokes will follow.

name: Pummelverdict
description: Swing the orb with the push of a driving gale in the breath behind it.

name: Crunchsolace
description: Step so the bearing to the foe stays unchanged while he moves.

name: Devout Headspike
description: Correct the shaft's angle in mid-parry as a sailor corrects for a crosswind and turn the cut aside.

name: Ruling Studball
description: Lock a spike on the foe's weapon and hold the bearing so the weapon stays on the line.

name: Vaunted Spikedrop
description: Let qi driven by the gale ride the shaft and fall with the orb as it comes down.

name: Storied Topspike
description: Strike a single spike along the held bearing at the point the eye has marked.

name: Choral Crunch
description: Strike, correct the bearing and strike again, each blow adjusted for how the foe has moved.

name: Inferno Spikeball
description: Drive the loaded orb in a wide arc on a surge of qi, striking every foe in the line of the gale.

name: Imperious Spikebase
description: Hold the bearing while qi builds in the shaft, then bear down along it and pin the foe in place.

name: Illustrious Steel Pummel
description: The school's joined stroke: the orb falls on a held bearing carried by the full drive of the gale.

name: Enshrined Spikering
description: Begin the round with the shaft angled low and the orb raised, covering the body before the first swing.

name: Thistletriumph
description: Drop the orb in the round's first fall, aimed at the foe's weapon shoulder.

name: Maulgrace
description: Circle one pace round the foe while the orb comes up for the round's second stroke.

name: Pummeledict
description: Rake the orb across the foe's flank at the turn of the round with a flick of qi at its end.

name: Venerable Ballsocket
description: Turn the round's open side to the foe and catch a thrust on the shaft as the orb passes behind.

name: Despotic Studball
description: Hook a spike on the foe's belt in passing and wrench him off his line.

name: Gallant Spikebase
description: Place a single spike through plate at the end of a turn, driving it with the shaft's full length.

name: Symphonic Maul
description: Run the whole round in one rush of strides and swings, ending at the point where it began.

name: Tyrannous Headspike
description: Close the round with the orb resting on the foe's weapon, qi settling it in place so he cannot lift it.

name: Sovereign Thornball
description: The school's closing blow: the round's whole momentum and a sworn breath of qi fall in the orb on the foe.

name: Stately Spikebase
description: Hold the shaft level at the chest with the orb hanging free, as at the plateau's edge.

name: Crunchedict
description: Swing the orb in a long arc that begins slowly and quickens like a gust off the plateau's edge.

name: Ballsolace
description: Step aside as the foe's weight comes forward, letting the orb drop onto his exposed back.

name: Lordly Spikeball
description: Push the field of qi along the shaft in a steady gust so each swing arrives with more weight.

name: Inviolate Prickball
description: Spin the shaft before the body so a screen of field qi stops lighter blows.

name: Intrepid Thornbite
description: Probe the foe's armor with the leading spike and find its weak point before the heavy stroke.

name: Despotic Spikebase
description: Snare the foe's weapon on a spike and pull it away on a short blast of qi.

name: Orchestral Pummel
description: Chain swing, parry and swing in a single gale of qi so the foe cannot find an opening.

name: Dauntless Studcrush
description: Gather qi into the leading spike and dive it through the armor, falling like a bird from the plateau's edge.

name: Penumbra Headspike
description: Bring a gale of gathered qi down with the orb and press the foe to the ground beneath it.

name: Triumphant Inferno Topspike
description: The school's gale stroke: the field of qi drives the orb from the plateau's edge onto the foe in one fall.

name: Faithful Shaftcollar
description: Stand still with the orb at rest and the shaft planted, taking the stance the last oath is sworn in.

name: Burrdecree
description: Cut down along the sworn line in the plain opening stroke of the final art.

name: Thistlevoyage
description: Advance on a held breath so that body and orb arrive together.

name: Maulverdict
description: Send a pulse of Core qi into the orb on a gale of breath so it lands with the weight of a falling stone.

name: Revered Topspike
description: Turn the shaft on the sworn line so a cut slides along it and is thrown aside.

name: Peremptory Thornball
description: Hook the foe's weapon and pull on a blast of Core qi so it is torn from his hand.

name: Paramount Spikebase
description: Thrust the spike through plate at the end of the breath, with Core qi behind its point.

name: Choral Maul
description: Deliver the final art's strokes in the order sworn, each carried on the same long breath.

name: Nucleus Shaftcollar
description: Bring the loaded orb down on the foe's weapon and hold it there with Core qi until he yields.

name: Valiant Spikering
description: The school's final stroke: the orb falls on a single sworn breath carrying all the wind's weight of Core qi.
